description: Reviewed UK local-area support-floor exclusions. The register ships empty in PR A; each future entry must carry measured shortfalls and an in-force adjudication.

local_authority/E06000053.reason: Reviewed exclusion of the local-authority support floor for Isles of Scilly (E06000053): population-proportional ladder assignment gives the area 7 positive-weight rows at the ruled K=4 (17 at K=10; microcosm#761 receipts section R1, identical on spine-i and spine-k), so the 50-row / ESS-50 / 50-source floor is unreachable by clone count. The area stays in the solve with its measured support and is flagged support_below_floor in area_support_summary.csv; consumers must treat its estimates as unsupported. Re-measured on every candidate; a passing area retires this entry (a stale exclusion fails the gate).
